Method of Attack: Spyware with broad spectrum of capabilities for cyber-espionage
Extracts proxy settings from browsers to send data to C&C server
Turns on user's microphone to record audio and send as MP3
Turns on user's webcam and takes screenshots
Monitors local drives, retrieves system info, makes system config alterations
Runs remote shell commands, manipulates registry keys, executes files, loads drivers
Safe-deletes its own files after data collection to prevent forensic detection
Turns itself into a proxy to facilitate communication between modules and C&C server
Attack Vector: All infection vectors possible including physical access to machine
Indicators of Compromise: Telemetry from compromised computers in Ukraine and Russia
